_readme: Known symbols for ES1's DBSIM.EXE (ES1DBSIM): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for that much memory (INT 21h AX=350Ch). On carry it returns -1; otherwise it stores EDX at 00090024, raises the high-water mark 00090028 to the block's end when the end is above it, and returns the block's address. Mem_InitHeap takes the heap's block from it, and operator new and malloc fall back on it while the heap is off.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: Camera_IsMountedOn
entries.description: (camera, object) in stack order: 1 when the camera's int16 +0x36 is 2 and its +0x32 is the object, otherwise 0. ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) leaves such an object out of the frame's draw; Sim_StartMission (0005a9dc) sets its main camera's +0x36 to 2.

entries.name: Cam_AttachOrbit
entries.description: (camera, centre, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte orbit centre to +0x38, stores object at +0x32, zeroes the orbit angles +0x26/+0x28/+0x2a, the distance +0x22, the angle rates +0x2c/+0x2e/+0x30 and the zoom rate +0x24, and sets the mode +0x36 to 1. ES2's Cam_AttachOrbit (DBSIM 0040109c) without its lock test. One call found by es2_xref, from 0005923c.

entries.name: Cam_AttachEye
entries.description: (camera, eye, object) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the 6-byte eye offset to +0x3e, stores object at +0x32 and sets the mode +0x36 to 2. ES2's Cam_AttachEye (DBSIM 0040111c) without its lock test.

entries.name: Cam_SetMode
entries.description: (camera, mode) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores mode in +0x36 when it is 0, 1 or 2 and does nothing otherwise. ES2's Cam_SetMode (DBSIM 00401148), which also takes 3 and tests the lock.

entries.name: Cam_Update
entries.description: (camera), callee-cleaned: places the camera by its mode +0x36. Mode 0, free: pitch +0x0c += +0x2c, clamped to +-0x3000 with +0x2c zeroed, roll +0x0e += +0x2e, heading +0x10 += +0x30; position +0 = that view's BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 applied to (0, int16 +0x24, 0) plus the position, its z raised to 100. Mode 1, orbit: distance +0x22 = clamp(+0x22 + +0x24, 2500, 30000); +0x2a += +0x30, +0x26 += +0x2c (clamped to +-0x3000, +0x2c zeroed), +0x28 += +0x2e; view = (+0x26, +0x28, +0x2a + the object's int16 +0x0a); eye = the object's frame (Context_GetTransform of object +6) applied to the centre +0x38, plus the view's rotation of (0, -distance, 0). When the eye's z is under 100: with the zoom rate +0x24 under 1 it restores the position, view and orbit angles it started the call with and returns; otherwise the pitch becomes Math_AsinBam((centre z - 100) * 0x4000 / distance), in the view and in +0x26, and the eye is recomputed. Mode 2, attached: through the object's vtable (+2) slot +0x28 node, Transform_Concat with the frame, the eye +0x3e applied and Transform_RotationToEuler plus +0x44/+0x46/+0x48 as the view; with a null node the frame applied to +0x3e and the object's own euler triple +6. ES2's Cam_Update (DBSIM 004011a0), which keeps the chase ring and mode 3, tests terrain height plus 0x226 where this tests 100, and keeps position and view at +4 and +0x10. Sim_Main calls it each frame on the main camera 000b5b8a.

entries.name: Cam_ApproachRate
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0xc0, Math_Q8Multiply(0x800, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachRate (DBSIM 00401c20).

entries.name: Cam_ApproachZoom
entries.description: (axis, rate) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Math_RateLimitedMoveToward(0x50, Math_Q8Multiply(0x400, axis), rate). ES2's Cam_ApproachZoom (DBSIM 00401c4c).

entries.name: Cam_Steer
entries.description: (camera, trigger, throttle, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Cam_Steer (DBSIM 00401c74) with no lock test. Mode 0: Cam_ApproachRate(-steer, +0x30); with trigger set Cam_ApproachZoom(-throttle, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(0, +0x2c), otherwise Cam_ApproachZoom(0, +0x24) and Cam_ApproachRate(throttle, +0x2c). Mode 1: the same with steer for the heading rate and throttle for the zoom rate. Other modes: nothing. Two calls found by es2_xref, from 0005771c and 0005a0c0.

entries.name: RegisterSubsystemLoader
entries.description: (phase, function) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores function and the int16 phase in the next 6-byte record at 000bbcb0, the record index being the int16 count at 0009011c, which it increments; Subsystem_RunPhase (00000af4) walks the records. Static initialisers call it, among them 0000d67c, 000081f8, 00004b80 and 00005e78 for Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48), Bullet_LoadResources (00007bb0), Base_LoadResources (000046ac) and Explosion_LoadResources (00005764) at phase 2. ES2's RegisterSubsystemLoader (DBSIM 00401d64).

entries.name: Subsystem_RunPhase
entries.description: (phase), callee-cleaned: calls, in order, each function of the 6-byte {function, int16 phase} records at 000bbcb0 (count int16 0009011c) whose phase matches. Sim_RenderFrame runs phase 5. ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase (DBSIM 00401d94).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00000af4, against ES2's Subsystem_RunPhase

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: sets up the heap object over the block: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its next link zeroed), and +0xc (free bytes) and +0x10 (their low mark) the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, which also becomes the block's size. Tags the block FBLK at +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries a block tag (FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0), else 0.

entries.name: Heap_LargestFree
entries.description: (heap), callee-cleaned: the largest size on the heap's free list (+8) less the 8-byte header, reading the list's head without testing it for null. Arena_Push sizes its arena with it on the heap 000ae4ac. ES1GO's Heap_LargestFree (00001091); ES2's Memory_LargestFreeBlock (DBSIM 00476dd0) subtracts 0x6c and clamps at 0.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, trackLow, size), callee-cleaned: first-fit allocation. Returns 0 for size 0. Rounds size + 8 up to a multiple of 8 and walks the free list (+8): a block of exactly that size is unlinked; a block more than 0x10 bytes larger is split, the tail staying on the list tagged FBLK; a block larger by 0x10 or less is passed over. The block is tagged ABLK, its payload zero-filled, its size taken off the free bytes (+0xc), and with trackLow set the low mark (+0x10) lowered to the free bytes. Returns the payload (header + 8), or 0 when no block fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: nothing for a null payload. Adds the block's size back to the free bytes (+0xc), tags it FBLK, inserts it into the free list (+8) in address order, and merges it with the free block before it and the one after it where they touch.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: size 0 frees the block (Heap_Free) and returns 0. A smaller size gives the tail back in place: to the free block that follows when there is one, otherwise as a new block freed through Heap_Free when the tail exceeds 0x10 bytes, and by moving the data into a new block (Heap_Alloc, memmove, Heap_Free) when it does not. A larger size takes the difference from a following free block large enough for it, and otherwise moves the data. The block after it is checked with Heap_IsBlock and its predecessor on the free list found with Heap_FindPrevFree. Lowers the low mark (+0x10) to the free bytes. Returns the payload, moved or not, or 0 when a move cannot allocate.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): the free block whose next link is the given block, walking the list from +8; 0 when the block heads the list or the walk ends without finding it.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): caps size at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 25000, takes a block that large from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (memory.cpp line 504, severity 5) through Assert_Report when it returns -1, makes it the heap 000ae4ac (Heap_Init) and sets 000901d4, which sends operator new, malloc and the frees to the heap. Returns the capped size.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 000901d4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The game's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, size) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0. It is the allocation a constructor makes for a null this (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). malloc is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, 1, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The game's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(000ae4ac, pointer) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise nothing. It is the release a destructor makes when bit 0 of its flags is set (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#constructors-and-destructors). free is the same body with the C convention.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The game's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET. It is the _malloc of the startup's argument vector (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/compiler.md#startup).

entries.name: free
entries.description: The game's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The game's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(000ae4ac, size, pointer), whether or not 000901d4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The game's calloc (count, size), C convention: count * size bytes from Heap_Alloc(000ae4ac, 1, ...) while 000901d4 is set, otherwise from X32_AllocMemory with -1 returned as 0, then memset to zero over the block's size from the header at payload-4, less 8. A block from X32_AllocMemory has no header, so that size is read from the 4 bytes before it.

entries.name: Context_GetTransform
entries.description: (context), callee-cleaned: the rotation an object's orientation block holds, built on demand. When the word at +0x26 is 0 it builds the Q14 rotation at +6 from the three int16 Euler angles at +0 with BuildEulerRotationMatrixQ14 (0005f0ac) and sets the word to 1; it returns context + 6. Most of the calls es2_naming.py callers lists pass an object's +6. ES2's class 'Context' (0x28 bytes, no vptr; MAT_OBJ's base at +0xc) has this layout, and ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000016e8, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: SimObject_InstallModelTransform
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned: installs an object's orientation as the renderer's model transform: Raster_SetModelTransform(Context_GetTransform(object + 6)), Context_GetTransform building the rotation on demand. es2_xref finds 16 calls and 10 stored pointers (draw slots of object vtables). ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform (DBSIM 00401fe4) builds the matrix inline.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile and disassembly at 00001854, against ES2's SimObject_InstallModelTransform

entries.name: TSObj_ReturnZero
entries.description: (object), callee-cleaned (RET 4), frameless: returns 0. Slot +0x10 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea, MAT_OBJ's 000902ca and three others.

entries.name: TSObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_OBJ's constructor, allocating 0x3b bytes when object is null. Installs DRAWABLE's vtable 0009020a at +2, zeroes the Context at +6 (its Euler angles at +0, its translation at +0x1a and its cached-rotation word +0x26), installs MAT_OBJ's vtable 000902ca and then TS_OBJ's 000902ea, stores TSShapeInstance_Ctor(0, shape) at +0x2e (0 for a null shape) and clears the 8 bytes at +0x32. ES2's TS_OBJ is 0x41 bytes with the shape instance at +0x34.

entries.name: MatObj_GetPosition
entries.description: (object): returns object + 0x20, the translation of the orientation block at +6. Slot +8 of MAT_OBJ's vtable 000902ca.

entries.name: TSObj_Render
entries.description: (object): TS_OBJ's draw, slot +4 of its vtable 000902ea: SimObject_InstallModelTransform (00001854)(object), then slot +0x20 of the shape instance at +0x2e. TSObj_RenderCopy (00020550) is the same code.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00001cdc; es2_naming diff against 00020550, identical

entries.name: TSObj_GetPosition
entries.description: (object): returns object + 0x20, the translation of the orientation block at +6. Slot +8 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea.

entries.name: TSObj_GetRadius
entries.description: (object): the int16 at +8 of the shape (+4) of the shape instance at +0x2e, sign-extended; 0 when there is no instance or no shape. Slot +0x14 of TS_OBJ's vtable 000902ea, the radius WorldShades_DistanceBand and ObjList_DrawFrameObjects read.

entries.name: ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames
entries.description: (holder, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the two-field shape-instance holder's constructor, allocating 8 bytes when holder is null. Stores the shape at +0 and, when the shape's word count +0x24 is non-zero, a copy of its word array +0x1c (Arena_Alloc from the arena 000bd954, then memmove) at +4, else 0. HeapBlockOwner_Dtor is its destructor. ES2's ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames (DBSIM 00402fc0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0000252c, against ES2's ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames

entries.name: HeapBlockOwner_Dtor
entries.description: (owner, flags), callee-cleaned: operator_delete of the block at owner + 4, then of owner itself when flags bit 0 is set; returns at once for a null owner. The destructor of the holder ShapeInstance_CtorCellFrames builds: destructors such as 00000338 (which ends in TSBase_Dtor) and 000028e0 run it on the holder at their +0x10 with flags 0. ES2's HeapBlockOwner_Dtor (DBSIM 00403020).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00002598, against ES2's HeapBlockOwner_Dtor

entries.name: MechType_BindHardpointSlots
entries.description: (slotList, boneIds, count, root) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores count at slotList+4 and a new array of count pointers at slotList+0, then for each bone id stores the root's vtable +0x28 answer for it, or null for a negative id. ES2's MechType_BindHardpointSlots (DBSIM 0040304c), whose arguments are (slotList, root, count, boneIds) and whose find goes through vtable +0x24.

entries.name: BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset
entries.description: (object, slot, formation) in stack order, callee-cleaned, object unread: copies the two int32 at 000bc190 + formation * 0x38 + slot * 8 - 8 (BFORMS.DAT's 56-byte formations of seven (x, y) slots) to the static point 000aee08 and returns it, its z 000aee10 set to 0 on the first call (flag 000aee06). Neither number is checked. ES2's BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset (DBSIM 00405b9c), which reads 10-byte slots through a per-formation pointer.

entries.name: Base_ApplyFormationOffset
entries.description: (object, position) in stack order, callee-cleaned: nothing when the object's int16 member slot +0x43 is 0; otherwise Formation_RotateAndAddOffset (0000d9a0)(object, position, BaseFormation_GetSlotOffset (0000441c)(object, slot, the formation number at +2 of the group the object's +0x3f points at)). ES2's Base_ApplyFormationOffset (DBSIM 00405c04). Caller found by es2_xref: 000044a4.

entries.name: Base_LoadResources
entries.description: No arguments: reads dat\bforms (severity-5 assert, base.cpp line 0x270, when the stream status is set), an int16 count to 000bc18e and that many 0x38-byte records into a __vec_new array at 000bc190; opens dat\bases (line 0x27b), reads its int16 count to 000bc188, builds that many 0x3e-byte records at g_BaseTypeTable (000bc18a) and count * 6 bytes at 000bc194, and reads 0x36 bytes into each record, setting its +0x3a to the type's 6-byte slot at 000bc194 when +0x06 is non-zero and to 0 when not; opens dat\basecol (line 0x296) and calls Collision_LoadRecordArray (000094f0)(slot, stream) for every type; keeps the greatest +0x02 plus one of the types with +0x06 zero at 000bc174 and of the others at 000bc16a, and the greatest +0x04 plus one at 000bc17e; loads dgs\bhulks with Shape_LoadAllRoots (tag 0x2bc0001) into 000bc180; allocates zeroed pointer arrays of 000bc174 entries at 000bc176 and 000bc17a and of 000bc16a entries at 000bc16c and 000bc170; and when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0 loads dba\basetex into 000bc184. A phase-2 loader. ES2's Base_LoadResources (DBSIM 00405fac), which also reads dat\lc_wpns and reads BASES.DAT field by field with its component arrays.

entries.name: LightManager_Construct
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_Construct (DBSIM 00406e44). Allocates 0x404 bytes for a null manager; __vec_ctor of twenty 0x23-byte slots at +0x6c (element constructor at the padding entry 00004ce5); the embedded light at +0x328 built as a TSLight (vtable 00090766 at +0x12) and retyped TSAmbientLight (0009077a), type 0 at +0x16; zeroes the live count +0x18 and the free-list counts +0x35c and +0x3b0; LightManager_SetFalloffConstants with 3000 and 2000 in stack order; then marks each slot free (+0) with a null light (+0x1f).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004bb8, against ES2's LightManager_Construct

entries.name: TSLight_DtorCopy
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of the light manager module's TSLight vtable 00090766: stores that vtable, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set; nothing for a null light. The same code as TSLight_Dtor (0005a964) for the module's own vtable copy.

entries.name: TSAmbientLight_Dtor
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TSAmbientLight's vtable 0009077a: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSAmbientLight_Dtor (DBSIM 0040798c).

entries.name: LightManager_SetFalloffConstants
entries.description: (manager, b, a) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores a >> 5 at +0x10 (A) and b >> 5 at +0x14 (B). LightManager_InitSubsystem passes 2000 and 10, so A = 0 and B = 62 as in ES2's LightManager_SetFalloffConstants (DBSIM 00406ee4).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004da8 and the push order at 000055c6

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotFalloff
entries.description: (manager, b, a, slot) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the slot's A (+0xf) = a >> 5 and B (+0x13) = b >> 5, slot = manager + 0x6c + index * 0x23, then LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotFalloff (DBSIM 00406f00). es2_xref finds its address only as the dword at 0002116c.

entries.name: LightManager_ClaimSlot
entries.description: (manager, point), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_ClaimSlot (DBSIM 00406f38): takes the first free slot of twenty, clears its free flag, copies the point to +1, seeds the int16 intensity +0xd with 0xff, copies the manager's A and B to +0xf and +0x13, appends the slot to the live array +0x1c and recomputes its cull radius; returns the index. With every slot busy it writes through an uninitialised local.

entries.name: LightManager_ReleaseSlot
entries.description: (manager, slot index), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_ReleaseSlot (DBSIM 00406fbc): sets the slot's free flag, moves the live array's last entry over it, recycles its light (+0x1f) with LightManager_RecycleLight and nulls it.

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotPosition
entries.description: (manager, point, slot index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies the int32 triple to the slot's +1. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotPosition (DBSIM 00407018).

entries.name: LightManager_SetSlotIntensity
entries.description: (manager, intensity, slot index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores the int16 at the slot's +0xd and, sign-extended, at +0x1b, and recomputes the cull radius. ES2's LightManager_SetSlotIntensity (DBSIM 00407048).

entries.name: LightManager_SetCameraPosition
entries.description: (manager, camera), callee-cleaned: copies the camera's position (+0, three int32) to the manager's +0. es2_xref finds its caller ObjList_DrawFrameObjects, which runs each frame, where ES2's LightManager_SetCameraPosition (DBSIM 0040707c) is called from Sim_RenderFrame.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004f60 and its call at 0002101a

entries.name: LightManager_SelectLightsForObject
entries.description: (manager, {x, y, z, radius} as four int32), callee-cleaned: ES2's LightManager_SelectLightsForObject (DBSIM 00407098). Unregisters the embedded light +0x328; for each live slot with a non-zero +0x1b: past the cull radius +0x17 it recycles the slot's light; otherwise, d = distance >> 5 (Point3I_DistanceBetween), when d is not 0 and Math_Atan2Guarded(x d, y radius >> 5) is below 8000 a directional light (Light_GetOrCreateDirectional) with intensity +0x1b * min(0xff, (B << 8) / (d + A)) >> 8 and direction (object - slot) * 0x800 / distance at +0xc, else a point light (Light_GetOrCreatePoint) with intensity +0x1b, +0x34 = A << 5, +0x38 = B * 0x20, +0x3c = +0x38 * intensity and the slot's position at +0. es2_xref finds its caller ObjList_DrawEntryRender, which calls it before each object's draw.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00004f78, diff against ES2's LightManager_SelectLightsForObject

entries.name: LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius
entries.description: (manager, slot), callee-cleaned: slot +0x17 = (B * 0x20 * the int16 intensity +0xd) / 10 + A * 0x20. ES2's LightManager_RecomputeCullRadius (DBSIM 0040735c).

entries.name: Light_GetOrCreateDirectional
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: pops a light from the free list +0x35c/+0x360, or allocates a 0x34-byte TSLight retyped TSSunLight (vtable 0009078e at +0x12, type 1 at +0x16), and registers it with Light_Register; returns it. ES2's Light_GetOrCreateDirectional (DBSIM 00407388).

entries.name: TSSunLight_DtorCopy
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of the light manager module's TSSunLight vtable 0009078e: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. The same code as TSSunLight_Dtor (0005a99c) for the module's own vtable copies.

entries.name: Light_GetOrCreatePoint
entries.description: (manager), callee-cleaned: pops a light from the free list +0x3b0/+0x3b4, or allocates a 0x40-byte TSLight retyped TSOmniLight (vtable 000907a2 at +0x12, type 2 at +0x16), and registers it with Light_Register; returns it. ES2's Light_GetOrCreatePoint (DBSIM 00407444).

entries.name: TSOmniLight_Dtor
entries.description: (light, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +4 of TSOmniLight's vtable 000907a2: stores that vtable and then TSLight's 00090766, TSContext_Dtor(light + 0x1e, 2) and TSContext_Dtor(light, 0), and operator_delete when flags bit 0 is set. ES2's TSOmniLight_Dtor (DBSIM 004075c1).

entries.name: LightManager_RecycleLight
entries.description: (manager, light), callee-cleaned: for a non-null light, Light_Unregister and a push onto the directional free list (+0x35c/+0x360) when its type +0x16 is 1, the point list (+0x3b0/+0x3b4) otherwise. ES2's LightManager_RecycleLight (DBSIM 00407500).

entries.name: EffectLight_Construct
entries.description: (handle, intensity, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: takes a handle from the pool 000aee18 for a null one (returns 0 when it is empty), stores the vptrs 000907b6 and 000907d6 at +2, claims a manager slot at the point (LightManager_ClaimSlot) into the int16 +6 and sets its intensity (LightManager_SetSlotIntensity). Explosion_Construct passes the type row's dword at +0x0c. ES2's EffectLight_Construct (DBSIM 00407604), whose handle is 0xe bytes.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000054b0 and its call at 00005c67

entries.name: EffectLight_Destruct
entries.description: (handle, flags), callee-cleaned: slot +0xc of the handle's vtable 000907d6: stores that vtable, releases the manager slot +6 (LightManager_ReleaseSlot), stores the base vtable 000907b6 and, when flags bit 0 is set, queues the handle on the pool's delete queue 000aee1c (ObjectPool_QueueForDelete). ES2's EffectLight_Destruct (DBSIM 0040765c).

entries.name: EffectLight_SetIntensity
entries.description: (handle, byte value), callee-cleaned: LightManager_SetSlotIntensity of the handle's slot +6. ES2's EffectLight_SetIntensity (DBSIM 004076a0). es2_xref finds its caller 00005d74, which passes the low byte of an entry of the explosion row's intensity ramp.

entries.name: EffectLight_SetPosition

entries.name: Ai_SelectTarget
entries.description: (this, mask) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the AI's target acquisition. Walks the object pointer array at *000bc416 (count int16 000bc41c, a null entry ending it) and returns the best-scoring candidate, or 0. A candidate must pass 0000dce8(this, mask, candidate). The group (+0x3f) designates it when Group_IsOrderTarget (0001ce3c)(group, candidate) holds and the group's word +4 is 1. A candidate with its byte +0x9e set is skipped unless the group designates it and the group's byte +0x14 is set. Its tier is 2 * d + 1, less 1 when any of its bytes +0x9f, +0x9e and +0x93 is set, d being 1 when the group designates it or mask bit 0 is clear; one below the tier bar (0 at the start) is skipped. Score: b = 0x1000 - (|bearing error| >> 3), the error being the heading from this +0x20 to the candidate's +0x20 (Math_HeadingToward) less this's heading +0xa, 0 with mask 0x20; Q10(100, b), raised inside a Math_DistanceBetweenPoints range of 25000 to b / max(range >> 11, 1) when that is larger; then Q10-multiplied by the weight tables 00091620 (candidate's +0x15e is this, unless mask bit 1), 00091628 (candidate's behaviour descriptor byte +9 clear), 00091630 (candidate's +0x15e is another object) and 00091638 (by the candidate's int16 +0x162), the first three indexed by this's vtable +0x50 (this, candidate); and divided by one more than the candidate's holders +0x15c, less one when this's +0x15e is the candidate, unless mask bit 2. A higher score or a higher tier replaces the best and sets the bar to its tier. ES2's Ai_SelectTarget (DBSIM 00411fa0) adds the cone limit and the range caps, scores Q10(70, b) and b / (range >> 12) inside 60000, and adds the locally-piloted test and the own-class mask bit.

entries.description: (mech, avoidance arg, desired speed, steer) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the HERC control law and gait machine, with the type record at +0x188. A machine other than the player (000bc42a) that is not immobilised runs 00011c80. Damage scales the desired speed by Q10 400 (+0xa3) or 750 (+0xa2), steer is clamped to +/-0x100, and the speed +0x224 moves toward the desired speed by typeRec +8 (Math_RateLimitedMoveToward). The gait machine then compares |speed| with last tick's on the locomotion thread +0x1c0, cutting to or requesting the type's sequences +0xe, +0x10, +0x12, +0x14, +0x46 and +0x7c with AnimThread_SetSequence (0006200c) and AnimThread_SetTarget (0006265c) and setting the playback rate +0x236: an immobilised machine off +0x7c falls to +0x46, requesting it at rate 100 with Sound_PlayAt 0x1e at +0x20 unless +0xae is latched, then running at rate 0x78 and, once the sequence has played, latching +0xae, calling 00013078(mech, 0x78, 0x96) and playing 0x29. The turn rate +0x222 then moves by typeRec +0xa toward Q8(steer, tent): the tent is 0 when a gait branch set its step flag this tick or |speed| is below 45; otherwise it rises from 0 at 45 to typeRec +2 midway between 45 and the top speed +6, and falls to half that at the top speed. The heading +0xa takes the turn rate and +0x2c, the orientation block's cached-rotation word, is cleared. ES2's Mech_LocomotionTick (DBSIM 00416a04) adds the terrain slope, the Turbo Pod and the minimum playback rate, and peaks its tent at Q10(1600).

entries.name: Terrain_LoadZoneShapes
entries.description: (theater, zone) in stack order, callee-cleaned, terrain.cpp: loads the shapes standing on a zone. For a negative zone it zeroes Zone_ShapeCount (000bc588), Zone_TheaterShapeRoots (000bc580) and Zone_ShapeObjects (000bc584) and returns. Otherwise it builds dat\zone<zone> by ltoa (radix 10) over the XXXX of a copy of 'zoneXXXX' (000924b0) and ResourcePath_BuildFolderName, opens it with VolRStream_CtorFromPath (severity-5 assert, terrain.cpp line 0x32, when it fails), reads the word at +0 into a local it does not use again and the record count into Zone_ShapeCount. Shape_LoadAllRoots(0, 0x2bc0001, dgs\<name>, &Zone_TheaterShapeRoots), the name Terrain_TheaterNames (000924a0)[theater], gives the root count k; it reads k * 24 bytes of dat\<name> into a __vec_new array of TheaterShapeRecord_ElementCtor elements at Zone_TheaterShapeRecords (000bc58a) and closes that file. When the count is not 0 it allocates count pointers at Zone_ShapeObjects and for each 20-byte record reads a shape index (2 bytes), a position (12) and three angles (6), and builds a 0x3f-byte object: TSObj_Ctor(object, roots[index]) and the vptr 000924be at +2 (both skipped when operator_new fails, the stores below not); the angles to +6 and the position to +0x20, the orientation block's angles and translation; 0 to +0x2c; at +0x3b the address of the index's 24-byte record, or 0 when that record's int32 at +8 is negative. Neither index is tested against a count. Closes the zone file. With a count of 0, Zone_ShapeObjects is left as it was.

ES2's ObjList_PointNearSegment (DBSIM 00428f38). Callers found by es2_xref: 0002161c, ObjList_SortCompareSegment (000216c4) twice, ObjList_SegmentEndpointNear (000219fc) twice.

entries.name: ObjList_SortCompareSegment
entries.description: (unread, newNode, node) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ObjList_EntryCompare (00021b20)'s case where one draw entry has a segment (kind +0x12 of 1 or 2; node's when both have). When the other entry's distance +0xe exceeds the segment entry's, or ObjList_PointNearSegment (000215e0) accepts neither the camera (0009256c) nor the other entry against it, the answer is whether newNode's entry is nearer. Otherwise it builds once per node (flag +0xc) the normal n = d x (d x e) at +0x11, d the segment and e the camera less its first end, with Vec3I_Cross (000662a5), each vector halved until Math_FastMagnitude3D is at most 32000, and the camera's side Vec3I_DotSign (000661a5)(n, e) at +0xd, and returns whether the other entry's position gives the same sign. ES2's ObjList_SortCompareSegment (DBSIM 0042900c), which has no first argument.

entries.description: (entryA, entryB) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns entryB + 0x18 when ObjList_PointNearSegment (000215e0)(entryB + 0x18, entryA), else entryB + 0x24 when ObjList_PointNearSegment(entryB + 0x24, entryA), else 0: the first of B's segment ends near A. entries.name: ObjList_SortCompareSegments

Asks ObjList_SegmentEndpointNear (000219fc) for an end of node's segment near newNode's entry, then one of newNode's near node's; with neither, whether newNode's entry is nearer (+0xe). Otherwise it moves the entry whose end was found to that end with kind +0x12 set to 0, calls ObjList_SortCompareSegment (000216c4)(0, that node, the other), restores the position and kind, and returns the answer, inverted when the moved entry was node's. Non-zero sends ObjList_TreeInsert (00021ba8) right.

entries.name: World_LoadTheater
entries.description: (header), callee-cleaned: ES2's World_LoadTheater (DBSIM 0042e010) for ES1's world file. With t header word 0, v word 9 and d word 8 it loads dpl\world<6t+2v> with Palette_LoadAndActivate (00027e5c) and opens wld\world<6t+2v+d>. Hzline_Ctor (00026180) builds g_TheaterHzline (000928d4); of the file's twelve leading int16 (ES2 reads fourteen), 0-7 go to the hzline as ES2's do (+0x6c, +0x54, +0x58, +0x5c, +0x60, and Hzline_SetColors (00026234) with 1, 4 and 7), short4 + short6 - 1 to 000928e0, short 8 to a local, 9 to World_FlatSetSelector (000928e2), 10 and 11 to 000bc5d0 and 000bc5d2; 000bc5ce = 0x40, 000bc5d4 = 0x62. Two int32-counted int32 tables to WorldShades_BandsTagged (000afdc4) and WorldShades_BandsTag0 (000afdc8), counts' low halves at 000bc5b8 and 000bc5ba; rows and cols int16 to 000bc5be and 000bc5bc; two cols x 4-byte range tables (64-byte stack buffers, cols unchecked) around an unused int16 expanded by Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges (000289e0) into WorldShades_LevelRanges (000afdbc), then two 4-byte ranges into WorldShades_BlendRanges (000afdc0); int16 cloud count, int16 point count, two int32 to WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (000bc5c6). Five NUL-terminated strings read a byte at a time, unbounded, into 12-byte stack buffers: the first, when not empty, to Hzline_LoadBitmapBank (00026dc8); the second, when not empty, a 0x113-byte object built by TexPoly_Ctor (000271c0) with the cloud count, vptr 000928f6, into World_Clouds (000928d8); the third, when not empty, Palette_LoadDpl(dpl\<name>) into ImpactPaletteObject (000928f0); the fourth and fifth to GndTex_Load. A non-zero point count builds PointScatter_Ctor (00026dec) into World_PointScatter (000928dc), with short 8 at its +0x15. Closes the file; opens cyc\world<6t+2v+d> with VolRStream_Open and, when it opens with a non-zero int16 count (000928e8), allocates 6 x count bytes (000928e4) and reads count records of three int16 at a 12-byte stride, registering each with PaletteCycle_Register (000281cc). World_LoadShades (00025bc8) with 'shades'; GndTex_Load (00028de8) with (fifth string, fourth string, short 0, short 5, short 6, short 4) in stack order; FlatObj_LoadResources (00006cf8) with World_FlatSetSelector; destroys the stream. No rmp file, Terrain_BindTextureBank or Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions, where ES2 has them.

entries.name: Palette_ToggleImpact
entries.description: No arguments: when ImpactPaletteObject (000928f0) is loaded, 000afdcc = 00027e7c(000afdcc) and 000928eb flips. ES2's Palette_ToggleImpact (DBSIM 0042ea70).

entries.name: Palette_RestoreFromImpact
entries.description: No arguments: when ImpactPaletteObject (000928f0) is loaded, 00027e7c(000afdd0) and 000928eb cleared. ES2's Palette_RestoreFromImpact (DBSIM 0042ea94).

entries.name: WorldShades_IsBeyondLastBand
entries.description: (distance, obj) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's WorldShades_IsBeyondLastBand (DBSIM 0042eab4), the tag at obj+0 and the radius from vtable slot +0x14: WorldShades_BandsTag0 (000afdc8) for tag 0, WorldShades_BandsTagged (000afdc4) otherwise, tag 8 adding WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (000bc5c6) entry 0 and tag 5 entry [radius >= 5000], clamped at 0; returns whether the table's last threshold is below distance, unsigned. ObjList_DrawFrameObjects (00021008) leaves such an object undrawn.

entries.name: Palette_BlendRangeByPitch
entries.description: (camera), callee-cleaned: while 000928ec is set, rewrites palette entries 64-79. Once (flag 00092a3e): reads the colours of entries 000bc5ce, 000bc5d0, 000bc5d2 and 000bc5d4 with Palette_GetEntry (00027f54) and builds 16 colours from 000bc5d0's to 000bc5d2's at 000afde4 with Palette_InterpolateColours (000283b0). Each call: step = 000928ee when it is not negative (then 000928ee = -1), otherwise ((pitch +0xc + 0x2000) & 0xffff) >> 10 capped at 15; end = entry 000bc5d4's colour while 000928eb is set, otherwise colour[step]; 16 colours from entry 000bc5ce's to end installed at entry 0x40 with Palette_InstallRange. Sits where ES2's Scene_DrawTerrainPass calls Palette_NoOp.

entries.name: Hzline_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_Ctor (DBSIM 0042eb5c). Allocates 0x71 bytes for a null this (ES2's object is 0x7a), calls the base constructor 000547b4, stores the vptr 00092aaa and the defaults +0x6c = 1, +0x54 = 3, +0x58 = 16, +0x5c = 1, +0x60 = 8, +0x64 = +0x68 = 1, +0x50 = 0, and the byte +0x70 = 1, where ES2 stores 0 at +0x70 and 1 at +0x71.

entries.name: Hzline_SetColors
entries.description: (this, lineOffset, groundColor, zenithColor) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_SetColors (DBSIM 0042ebbc): +0x28 = (zenithColor + band count +0x58 - 1) & 0xffffff, +0x2c = groundColor & 0xffffff, +0x30 = lineOffset.

entries.name: Hzline_Draw
entries.description: (this, canvasOrigin, camera) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Hzline_DrawWithOffset (00026280)(this, canvasOrigin, the line offset +0x30, camera). ES2's Hzline_Draw (DBSIM 0042ebe8).

entries.name: Hzline_DrawWithOffset
entries.description: (this, canvasOrigin, offset, camera) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_DrawWithOffset (DBSIM 0042ec08) on the camera's pitch (+0xc, negated into +0x34) and roll (+0xe into +0x36): Hzline_BuildHorizon (00026348), both end rows + offset >> 1, both ends + canvasOrigin when it is non-null, Hzline_FillSky (0002650c), both end rows + 1, Hzline_FillGround (000267d8)(this, canvasOrigin.x or 0, camera); then Hzline_BlitHorizonStrip (00026ac8)(this, canvasOrigin, offset, camera, +0x50) when either end row + offset is above 0, +0x50 is set and the preferences byte 000bd565 is non-zero.

entries.name: Hzline_BuildHorizon
entries.description: (this, canvasOrigin) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_BuildHorizon (DBSIM 0042ec68) with ends always +-256 px from the midpoint ((cos roll, sin roll) >> 6), a zero cos(pitch) replaced by cos(pitch - 1), and a non-null canvasOrigin moving both ends by ((cos roll * origin.y) >> 14, -(sin roll * origin.x) >> 14) where ES2 lengthens the line. Writes the ends +0x38..+0x44 (Raster_ProjectionCentre, its y 000b5ee4, the line offset +0x30, Raster_FocalShift) and the step pair +0x48/+0x4c, behind ES2's never-true negation test.

entries.name: Hzline_FillSky
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_FillSky (DBSIM 0042ee88), drawing nothing while both end rows are above the view's top (render context 000bdbda +0x214). Rolled, the first quad starts at the line and steps (-sin roll * h, -t) then (-sin roll * h, -cos roll * h), and beyond the last band one Raster_DrawPolygonReversed polygon reaches the view-rect corners on the sky side (+0x210/+0x218, +0x214/+0x21c) in the zenith colour, where ES2 starts 2h below the line and draws a 5000-px quad.

entries.name: Hzline_FillGround
entries.description: (this, originX, camera) in stack order, callee-cleaned: nothing while both end rows are below the view's bottom (+0x21c). When +0x70 is set and the preferences byte 000bd567 exceeds 000956be (240), GndTex_Draw (00029120)(originX, Raster_FocalShift, 8, +0x44, +0x3c, camera + 0xc, camera). Otherwise the banded fill of ES2's Hzline_FillGround (DBSIM 0042f0b0) with its one-colour flag clear: +0x60 - 1 bands from colour +0x2c + +0x60 - 1 down one entry a band, the first +0x6c >> 1 rows, then +0x5c rows each, then colour +0x2c to the bottom; Raster_FillRect level, Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch rolled, closing on the view-rect corners on the ground side.

entries.name: Hzline_BlitHorizonStrip
entries.description: (this, canvasOrigin, offset, camera, bank) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_BlitHorizonStrip (DBSIM 0042f398) without the coordinate shifts. With n frames (+4) of width w (frame 0's +6): x = (heading +0x10 << 16) / ((0x10000 / n << 16) / w), stepped back by n * w to the view's left edge (+0x210, + origin.x); frames step by w along the line (rolled: (cos, -sin) * w from the line's midpoint moved by x - 160); skipping those left of the view, it draws up to n frames, cycling the frame number, while x is left of left + 320, each standing on the line: Bitmap_Blit level, Bitmap_BlitRotatedUnpacked (00067214) by -roll rolled.

entries.name: Hzline_LoadBitmapBank
entries.description: (this, name), callee-cleaned: ES2's Hzline_LoadBitmapBank (DBSIM 0042f65c): ClassItem_LoadFromFile(dba\<name>) into +0x50. World_LoadTheater (000251c4) calls it with the world file's first string when not empty, dba\world<N> in retail.

entries.name: PointScatter_Ctor
entries.description: (this, count), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x17 bytes for a null this; +0 = __vec_new of count 12-byte points built by PointScatter_PointCtor (00026e5c, through its padding entry 00026e59); +5 = count and +0x15 = 0xff as int16; byte +4 = 0. World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds one with the world file's point count and stores its short 8 at +0x15.

entries.name: PointScatter_PointCtor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: the element constructor of PointScatter_Ctor (00026dec)'s 12-byte points: allocates 12 bytes for a null this and stores nothing.

entries.name: PointScatter_Update
entries.description: (this, centre), callee-cleaned: when the byte +4 is clear, PointScatter_Scatter (00026ee0) around centre and sets +4; then, when 000bd567 is less than 000956be, stores count +5 x 000bd567 / 000956be at +7 as int16 and calls PointScatter_Draw (00026fe0)(this, centre).

entries.name: PointScatter_Scatter
entries.description: (this, centre), callee-cleaned: copies centre's three int32 to +9, +0xd and +0x11, and for each of the +5 points draws an angle a and a radius r from Math_RandomNext(000b5c48) and stores x = centre.x + Math_Q14Multiply(2r, Math_CosBam(a)), y = centre.y + Math_Q14Multiply(2r, Math_CosBam(a - 0x4000)), z = 0.

entries.name: PointScatter_Draw
entries.description: (scatter, camera), callee-cleaned: clears the model transform, installs a pixel brush {0, colour} from its stack at the render context's +0x228 and leaves it there; for each of the first +7 points, d = Math_FastMagnitude2D of the point less the camera in x and y: when the camera moved since the centre +9 and d exceeds 70000 the point is reflected through the midpoint of the old and new camera x, y; when Raster_ModelToView puts it beyond the camera's near plane +0x1e it is projected (Raster_PerspectiveDivide, Raster_ProjectToScreen) and plotted with Gfx_PlotPixel in the colour +0x15, a second pixel to its right within 30000, and within 20000 (x+2, y) and (x+2, y-1) in colour - 2 and (x+1, y-1) in colour - 4. Stores the camera's position as the centre. es2_xref finds its caller PointScatter_Update.

entries.name: TexPoly_Ctor
entries.description: (this, count, name), callee-cleaned: ES2's TexPoly_Ctor (DBSIM 0042f700), its offsets 4 lower. Allocates 0x107 bytes for a null this; stores the vptrs 00092ade, 00092b02, 00092b2e, 00092b5a, 00092b86 and 00092bb2 in turn, __vec_ctor of five 12-byte points (00027498) at +0x21, TexPoly's vptr 00092bde; +0xe = __vec_new of count x 4 12-byte points (00027498), +0x12 = __vec_new of count 6-byte angle triples (00027510), +0x16 = count zeroed bytes, count at +0x1f and +0xf9 as int16, +0x1a = ClassItem_LoadFromFile(dba\<name>); zeroes the dwords at +0x5d (three), +0x6d, +0x71 and +0x75, the five points and the byte +0x1e. World_LoadTheater (000251c4) builds one into a 0x113-byte object with the world file's cloud count and second string, clouds2 in every retail file, and retypes it with the clouds' vptr 000928f6.

entries.name: TexPoly_RandomPointOnCircle
entries.description: (poly, radius, centre, _, angles, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: slot +0x28 of TexPoly's vtable 00092bde: a = Math_RandomNext, angles = (0, 0, a), out = (centre.x + Math_Q14Multiply(radius, Math_CosBam(a)), centre.y + Math_Q14Multiply(radius, Math_CosBam(a - 0x4000)), +0x75). ES2's TexPoly_RandomPointOnCircle (DBSIM 0042f860), which shifts the two offsets by its last argument.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00027540, diff against ES2's TexPoly_RandomPointOnCircle

entries.name: TexPoly_SetQuadAndRadius
entries.description: (poly, radius, z, ysize, xsize) in stack order, callee-cleaned: radius at +0x69, xsize at +0x6d, ysize at +0x71, z at +0x75, and the first four points at +0x21 as the rectangle (0, 0)-(xsize, ysize) at height z. ES2's TexPoly_SetQuadAndRadius (DBSIM 0042f914), its offsets 4 higher.

entries.name: TexPoly_SetFifthVertex
entries.description: (poly, point), callee-cleaned: copies the int32 triple to +0x51, the fifth of the points at +0x21, the poly's normal. ES2's TexPoly_SetFifthVertex (DBSIM 0042f950).

entries.name: TexPoly_SetupRings
entries.description: (poly, camera), callee-cleaned: slot +0x24 of TexPoly's vtable 00092bde: ring count +0xf5 = +0x69 / +0x6d; for ring i, +0x6d * (i + 1) + +0x6d / 2 at +0x9b[i], the int16 0xffff / ((+0x6d * (i + 1) * 4) / +0x71) at +0x7d[i] and a Math_RandomNext word at +0xd7[i]; then the camera's position at +0xfb and 1 at +0x1e. ES2's TexPoly_SetupRings (DBSIM 0042f970).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00027638, diff against ES2's TexPoly_SetupRings

entries.name: TexPoly_DrawAtPoints
entries.description: (poly, camera), callee-cleaned: slot +0x34 of TexPoly's vtable 00092bde: runs slot +0x24 while +0x1e is clear; makes +0x1a the active bitmap bank 000bdb5e, Poly_IndexList 000bdb62 and the surface list 000b6732 = +0x5d; for each of the +0x1f points at +0xe, when the camera's x or y moved since +0xfb, a point unflagged in the bytes +0x16 and farther (Math_FastMagnitude2D) than +0x69 + +0x79 is reflected through the midpoint of the old and new camera positions and flagged, a flagged one nearer than +0x69 - +0x79 unflagged; each point below +0xf9 gets slot +0x2c with its distance, Raster_SetModelTransform at its position unrotated, and slot +0x30. Stores the camera's position at +0xfb. ES2's TexPoly_DrawAtPoints (DBSIM 0042fa18), without its depth-fade reset.

entries.name: TexPoly_Render
entries.description: (poly), callee-cleaned: slot +0x30 of TexPoly's vtable 00092bde: takes surface entry 0 when Raster_FrontFacing of the normal point +4 (read as int16) and the centre point +6 is positive and entry 2 with the back flag otherwise, as a frame of the active bank (000bdb5e +8); for a non-null frame installs the brush {5, 4, corners, frame + 4} at the render context's +0x22c, the corners (0, 0), (u, 0), (u, rows - 1), (0, rows - 1) with u = columns - 1 rounded down to a multiple of 8, projects with Poly_ProjectIndexedVertices, clips with Poly_ClipRingToNearPlaneWithUV when it returns 1, fills with PolyFill_FillThenOutline and restores PolyFill_FillBrush. ES2's TexPoly_Render (DBSIM 0042fc34) bitmap-brush branch, taken always.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 000279a4, against ES2's TexPoly_Render

entries.name: Clouds_Setup
entries.description: (clouds, camera), callee-cleaned: slot +0x24 of the clouds' vtable 000928f6: TexPoly_SetQuadAndRadius(200000, 10000, 25000, 25000), margin 10000 at +0x79, TexPoly_SetFifthVertex(0, 0, -1), TexPoly_SetupRings; places each cloud with slot +0x28 at (Math_RandomNext & 0xffff) << 1 from the camera; sets the wind +0x107 = (Q14(s cos w), Q14(s sin w), 0), w = Math_RandomNext, s = 50 + Math_RandomBelow(100); stores Math_RandomBelow(3) at +0x65.

entries.name: Clouds_DriftAndDraw
entries.description: (clouds, camera), callee-cleaned: slot +0x34 of the clouds' vtable 000928f6, which Scene_DrawTerrainPass calls each frame: the number drawn +0xf9 = (+0x1f * (000bd566 + 1)) >> 8, the wind +0x107 added to each drawn cloud's position, then TexPoly_DrawAtPoints.

entries.name: Palette_LoadAndActivate
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: ES2's Palette_LoadAndActivate (DBSIM 00430394): Palette_LoadDpl(path) into the active palette pointer 00092c20, then calls Palette_BuildTextureShadeTables (00028b28) (through 00028b27), which ES2's does not.

entries.name: Palette_InstallRange
entries.description: (source, count, base) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies count dwords from source into the active palette's entries (*(00092c20 + 8)) from index base, and widens the dirty range 00092c28..00092c2c to cover them, starting it afresh when the flag 00092c30 is clear and setting the flag. ES2's Palette_InstallRange (DBSIM 004303c4).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 00027e98, against ES2's Palette_InstallRange

entries.name: Palette_GetEntry
entries.description: (index), callee-cleaned: returns the active palette's (00092c20) colour dword at +8 [index].

entries.name: Palette_SetRampsToRange
entries.description: (range, count, first) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Palette_SetRampsToRange (DBSIM 00430518): for count records of the array at 00092c34 from first, writes range's consecutive indices start .. start + length - 1 into the record's entries and its length, the range read without advancing; then Raster_SetColourRamps (000691f8)(first, count, records, 0).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Register
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: ES2's PaletteCycle_Register (DBSIM 00430638): stores record in the first empty slot of the five at 000bc5d6, its due time (the dword 000981c4 +the record's int16 +4, where ES2 calls Time_GetCoarseTicks) at 000bc5ea and 0 at 000bc5fe, returning 1; 0 when all five are taken.

entries.name: Palette_InterpolateColours
entries.description: (out, levels, count, to, from) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Palette_InterpolateColours (DBSIM 004307b0): for each of count colour pairs, levels - 1 colours from from's stepping by (to - from) * 256 / (levels - 1) per channel in 8.8 fixed point, then to's, each with 0x01 in its top byte.

entries.name: Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges
entries.description: (out, levels, rampCount, to, from) in stack order, callee-cleaned: ES2's Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges (DBSIM 00430d08), its loops written as do-whiles: for each of rampCount (int16 start, int16 count) pairs, levels ranges from from's to to's in 8.8 fixed point, the last exactly to's.

entries.name: Palette_UnpackColour
entries.description: (colour, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes the colour dword's bytes 0, 1 and 2 to out as three int16.

entries.name: Palette_BuildTextureShadeTables
entries.description: No arguments: when 00092c40 is null, builds eight 256-byte colour tables there from the active palette (00092c20) and stores the array at 000973f0 and 8 at 000973f4 and 000973f8. Entry c of table L: for each ramp (palette +0x10, count +0xc) holding c, the last deciding, ratio = (entry (len-1)*L/7 << 10) / entry Math_Q10Multiply(len-1, 0x28a) per channel (0 for a zero channel); c unchanged when no ramp holds c; otherwise the first palette index nearest (Colour_Distance (000644c8), below 1000) to c scaled by ratio with Math_Q10Multiply. Palette_LoadAndActivate (00027e5c) calls it through 00028b27.

entries.name: GndTex_Load
entries.description: (fadeName, bankName, horizonGap, groundBandHeight, groundBandCount, groundColor) in stack order, callee-cleaned, gndtex.cpp: 00092c4c = 1; builds dba\<bankName>.64k from 00092c50 and 00092c55, calls GndTex_Alloc (00029714)(0x140, 0x17c) and GndTex_LoadTexture (00029830)(name). Opens dat\<fadeName> (severity-5 assert, gndtex.cpp line 0x3f, when it fails), reads an int32 count to 000b0d74 and count int32 to a new array at 000b0d78; allocates count x 4 bytes at 000b0d70 and replaces them with a 0x3c-byte array of 15 pointers; 000b0d7c = groundBandHeight, 000b0d84 = horizonGap >> 1, 000b0d80 = 15, 00092c80 = 0x140. Table i (0-14) of 16 bytes: with b = groundColor & 0xf0 and top = groundColor + groundBandCount - 1, s = top - (b + j), less 1 more when negative, entry j = s * i / 14 + b + j. World_LoadTheater (000251c4) passes the world file's fifth and fourth strings and its shorts 0, 5, 6 and 4.

entries.name: GndTex_BuildRowTable
entries.description: (originX, rows, first, shift, pitch, z) in stack order, callee-cleaned: unless z, pitch and originX equal 00092c44, 00092c48 and 000b0d6c and rows is at most 000b0d68, stores them and fills {left, D, right} int32 triples at 000afe68 for rows k = first .. first + rows - 1: (q0, q1) = Math_Rotate2DPoint((-render context +0x224 - k - 1, 1 << shift), Math_BuildRotation2D(-pitch)); D = q0 ? (-z * q1) / q0 : 10000000; (s0, s1) = (-z, D) rotated by the transposed matrix (Math_TransposeRotation2D); left = ((originX - 160) * s1) >> shift, right = ((originX + 159) * s1) >> shift.

entries.name: GndTex_Draw
entries.description: (originX, shift, texShift, rightRow, leftRow, angles, camera) in stack order, callee-cleaned: draws the textured ground. start = max((leftRow + rightRow) >> 1, view top); returns when cy (top - origin y) is negative; rows to the view's bottom (rolled: from a rotated corner), capped at 319, and the span width 00092c80 (rolled: from the roll); GndTex_BuildRowTable (00028fbc); per row, a fade table from TEX.DAT's distances (000b0d78, the first 000b0d84 rows table 14), the row ends through Math_BuildRotation2D(heading) and the eye (x, y) masked to 2^(texShift + 8) - 1 (Transform2D_ApplyToPoint), u/v and their steps ((right - left) * 0xcc >> texShift) to 00092c8c..00092ca4, and GndTex_DrawSpan (0002991d) into the bitmap 000b0d88; then Bitmap_Blit at (0, start), or Bitmap_BlitRotatedUnpacked (00067214) by -roll.

entries.name: GndTex_Alloc
entries.description: (rows, cols) in stack order, callee-cleaned: unless 00092c70 is set, allocates the 64 KB texture at 00092c74, gets its selector with GndTex_AllocSelector (000298b8) and on success fills the bitmap header 000b0d8c (rows, cols, 8 bits, +5 bit 4, size rows * cols) and allocates its buffer 000b0d96; zeroes both and sets 00092c70, else frees the texture. Returns 00092c70. GndTex_Load passes 320 and 380.

entries.name: GndTex_Free
entries.description: No arguments: when 00092c70 is set, GndTex_FreeSelector (000298fe), frees the texture 00092c74 and the buffer 000b0d96, and clears 00092c70, 00092c72 and both pointers. Callers found by es2_xref: 0005a7b8 and 0005b568.

entries.name: GndTex_LoadTexture
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: when 00092c70 is set and the file opens, reads its first 0x10000 bytes into the texture 00092c74 and returns 1; otherwise 0.

entries.name: GndTex_AllocSelector
entries.description: No arguments, no frame: INT 21h AX=3504h with BX = DS, adds the texture pointer 00092c74 to ECX, AX=3501h, keeps the returned BX at 00092c72, AX=3503h, then AX=3505h with ECX = 0x10000; returns 1, or 0 on a carry. GndTex_DrawSpan reads the texture through that selector in GS.

entries.name: GndTex_FreeSelector
entries.description: No arguments, no frame: loads BX from 00092c72 and, unless ZF is already set on entry (MOV sets no flags), zeroes ES, FS and GS and calls INT 21h AX=3502h; returns 1. In GndTex_Free (000297f0) the flag comes from its own test of 00092c70 and is clear.

entries.name: GndTex_DrawSpan
entries.description: No arguments: one ground row. Jumps to 0002acd5 - 13 * 00092c80, into 380 unrolled 13-byte steps (00029989-0002acd4) each writing palette[fade][texel] = byte [EBX + GS:[v << 8 | u]] to ES:EDI and stepping u (CL, fraction in EAX's high word) by du (DL, ESI) and v (CH, EDX's high word) by dv (DH, EBP), loaded from 00092c8a..00092ca6; EDI from 00092c78, EBX from 00092c7c, GS from 00092c72. The steps end in the RET at 0002acda.

entries.name: Cockpit_PushCanvasContext
entries.description: Increments the byte at 00092d7d, saves the installed render context (000bdbda) in the dword array at 000b0df4 at that index, and installs the cockpit's own render context, CockpitViewInstance's (00092d1c) +4, with Raster_InstallRenderContext. Cockpit_PopRenderContext undoes it. ES2's Cockpit_PushCanvasContext (DBSIM 004311e0).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002b00c, against ES2's Cockpit_PushCanvasContext

entries.name: Cockpit_PopRenderContext
entries.description: Reinstalls the render context Cockpit_PushCanvasContext saved at 000b0df4[00092d7d] with Raster_InstallRenderContext and decrements the index byte 00092d7d. ES2's Cockpit_PopRenderContext (DBSIM 00431210).
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002b03c, against ES2's Cockpit_PopRenderContext

entries.name: Widget_DrawToCockpit
entries.description: (offset, rect, which) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies a widget's rect between the display's two pages. Returns 0 unless CockpitView_RectCornerVisible(rect) is 1 and the byte +0x18 of the view manager at CockpitViewManagerPublished (000bc5a0) is 0. The GL display at 000bdd28 holds the pages at +0x88 and +0x8c: which = 1 copies from +0x8c to +0x88, and returns 0 while 000b5bca is set; any other value copies from +0x88 to +0x8c. Under Cockpit_PushCanvasContext it stores the source page at the display's +0x38 and the draw page at +0x3c, each also to 00098dd6 / 00098dda and through g_RasterRoutines slots 16 and 17 (0009df14, 0009df18); copies the type-0 region {rect} with Region_CopyBetweenPages (00066914) at the offset, 000b0dd4 when offset is null, between slot 31 (0009df50) and slot 30 (0009df4c); puts back the draw page it found, pops the context and returns 1. ES2's Widget_DrawToCockpit (DBSIM 0043122c) has these steps, tests the view manager's +0x1c, and adds a gate on Display_UseScrollWindow, the video-mode offsets 004d25da/004d25de and a one-pixel widening of the rect for scaled modes.
entries.source: ES1DBSIM decompile at 0002b058, against ES2's Widget_DrawToCockpit

entries.name: CockpitView_RectCornerVisible
entries.description: (rect{x0, y0, x1, y1}), callee-cleaned: 0 when the byte +0x20b of CockpitViewInstance (00092d1c) is set; otherwise 1 when the corner (x0, y0) or the corner (x1, y1) lies in the 320 x 200 box (inclusive extents 0x13f and 200) whose origin is the cockpit render context's (+4) +0x210 plus +0x220 and +0x214 plus +0x224, else 0. ES2's CockpitView_RectCornerVisible (DBSIM 00431410) tests +0x20f and subtracts the video-mode offsets from the rect.
