entries.name: Poly_ViewCache
entries.description: 1000 int32 {x, y, z} view-space points; the projectors store each vertex's transformed point here and the near-plane clips interpolate from it. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ViewCache (006c6d66).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenCache
entries.description: 1000 int32 {x, y} screen points, each projected vertex's, copied for a point marked 2. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ScreenCache (006c9c46).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenPoints
entries.description: The ring to fill: 32 int32 {x, y} screen points, count at Poly_ScreenCount. ES2's DBSIM Poly_ScreenPoints (006cbb86).

entries.name: Poly_ScreenCount
entries.description: The ring's point count (uint16), set by the projectors and the near-plane clips. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc86.

entries.name: g_BaseTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 0x3e-byte structure type records Base_LoadResources (000046ac) builds and reads dat\bases into; the count is the int16 at 000bc188.

entries.name: g_ExplosionTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to dat\explos's 0x2c-byte rows, read by Explosion_LoadResources (00005764); the count is the int16 at 000bc1b4. ES2's g_ExplosionTypeTable, of 0x28-byte rows.

entries.name: g_ExplosionShapes
entries.description: Pointer to dts\explos's root array, loaded by Explosion_LoadResources (00005764). ES2's g_ExplosionShapes.

entries.name: g_BulletTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to dat\bullets's 10-byte records, read by Bullet_LoadResources (00007bb0); the count is the int16 at 000bc1fa.

entries.name: ProjDat_RecordTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 19 0x24-byte projectile records Weapons_LoadResourceTables (0000bf48) reads from the end of dat\weapons. ES2's ProjDat_RecordTable, read from dat\proj.

entries.name: g_MechTypeCount
entries.description: int16: the number of chassis slots allocated, set to 0 by Mech_LoadResources and incremented by MechTypeSlot_Allocate; Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates this many records.

entries.name: g_MechTypeSlotIndex
entries.description: 16 bytes, one per chassis type: its slot, or 0xff for none. Mech_LoadResources fills it with 0xff, MechTypeSlot_Allocate writes it and MechTypeSlot_GetIndex reads it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeNames
entries.description: Pointer to the name table LoadNameList builds from nam\mechs, indexed by chassis type; MechType_InitOne takes a type's file name from it.

entries.name: g_MechTypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the chassis records, 0x1c4 bytes per slot, that Mechs_InitAllTypes allocates and MechType_InitOne fills.

entries.name: g_MechTextureGroupSlots
entries.description: Four dwords, the banks dba\light, medium, heavy and enemy that Mech_LoadResources loads when g_LowMemory (000bda98) is 0; MechType_InitOne stores the one a chassis' texture group (record +0x96) picks at each root's +0x26. ES2's g_MechTextureGroupSlots (DBSIM 004a9df6) is seven 8-byte slots whose address is stored instead.

entries.name: ScriptDatHeader
entries.description: The 20-byte header DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\script.dat: ten int16 header words, word 0 the theater, word 1 the zone, words 8 and 9 the world file's. Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) passes the dword at 000bc4a2, word 3, to FUN_0000f0f0 and Mission_TotalSalvage. ES2's ScriptDatHeader (DBSIM 004a9ed2).

entries.name: Salvage_PairCount
entries.description: int16: the number of salvage pairs at Salvage_Pairs (000bc4b4), which Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat ahead of them.

entries.name: Salvage_Pairs
entries.description: Pointer to the salvage pairs, two int16 each, that Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes to data\results.dat; Mech_SalvageValue (00014034) passes FUN_0001f7e8 a pair for each surviving hardpoint of a wreck.

entries.name: MissionVars
entries.description: The 100 int16 campaign flags, 200 bytes, that DBSim_LoadScriptDat (0001d850) reads from data\mission.var, zeroing flag 7 (000bc4c6), and Mission_WriteResults (0001d698) writes back. Action_Activate (0001cc5c) and Group_ReportIfAllOutOfAction (0001d524) write a flag by an operation; Mission_WriteResults adds 25000 per unit of flag 7 to the salvage award. ES2's counters at DBSIM 004a9ef4 are 1,000.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRoots
entries.description: Pointer to the array of root shapes Shape_LoadAllRoots loads from the theater's dgs\<name> in Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238); a zone's 20-byte records index it. Null after a load with a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeObjects
entries.description: Pointer to the array of Zone_ShapeCount (000bc588) object pointers Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) builds, one 0x3f-byte object (TS_OBJ and a pointer at +0x3b, vptr 000924be) per zone record. Null after a load with a negative zone; a load with a count of 0 leaves it as it was.

entries.name: Zone_ShapeCount
entries.description: int16: the zone file's record count (its word at +2), the number of objects at Zone_ShapeObjects (000bc584). Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) reads it, or sets 0 for a negative zone.

entries.name: Zone_TheaterShapeRecords
entries.description: Pointer to the theater's 24-byte shape records, one per root shape, read from dat\<name> by Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) into a __vec_new array of TheaterShapeRecord_ElementCtor (000204d8) elements. A zone object's +0x3b points at its shape's record unless that record's int32 at +8 is negative.

entries.name: CockpitViewManagerPublished
entries.description: The cockpit view manager, stored by CockpitViewManager_Publish and returned by CockpitViewManager_Published. Widget_DrawToCockpit tests its byte +0x18. ES2's CockpitViewManagerPublished (DBSIM 004cfa20).

entries.name: WorldShades_TypeTable
entries.description: Pointer to the 5-byte records {byte count, pointer to count two-byte pairs} World_LoadShades (00025bc8) reads from dat\shades, the record count byte at 000bc5c4. ES2's WorldShades_TypeTable (DBSIM 004cfd64).

entries.name: WorldShades_DistanceOffsets
entries.description: Two int32, 000bc5c6 and 000bc5ca, read from the world file after its two counts by World_LoadTheater (000251c4). ES2's WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (DBSIM 004cfd6c).

entries.name: g_LowMemory
entries.description: int16: set to 1 at 000595b1 in Sim_Main (00059350) when the heap Mem_InitHeap (00001524) returns is under 0x3c45b0 bytes; a search of the disassembly dump for the address finds that store and 14 compares. When it is set Mech_LoadResources (000198f0) loads no texture banks and MechType_InitOne (00019cf0) skips record +0x48's count of shape roots.

entries.name: Raster_ViewTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed view transform, written by Raster_SetViewTransform. ES2's DBSIM 006c6078.

entries.name: g_ModelTransformPtr
entries.description: Pointer to the installed model transform, the identity at Transform_Identity (000b5eb4) when null is installed; written by Raster_SetModelTransform. ES2's g_ModelTransformPtr (DBSIM 006c607c).

entries.name: Raster_FocalShift
entries.description: The installed camera's focal shift (+0x1a): the projection is (x << shift) / depth, and 0 selects the orthographic form. ES2's DBSIM 006c60ac.

entries.name: Raster_NearPlane
entries.description: The installed camera's near-plane depth (+0x1e). ES2's DBSIM 006c60b0.

entries.name: Raster_OrthoDivisor
entries.description: The installed camera's orthographic divisor (+0x22), set only when the focal shift is 0. ES2's DBSIM 006c60b4.

entries.name: Light_ActiveCount
entries.description: Number of entries in Light_ActiveList. ES2's DBSIM 006c612c.

entries.name: Light_ActiveList
entries.description: The active light list, ten light pointers, which the shade functions walk. ES2's DBSIM 006c6130.

entries.name: Light_ModelSpaceEnabled
entries.description: Byte: when set, Raster_SetModelTransform moves each registered light into the model's space and the save and restore carry the lights' copies. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc88.

entries.name: Bitmap_UseCallerScratch
entries.description: Flag Bitmap_Blit tests after drawing a packed bitmap: while it is 0 the blit deletes Bitmap_UnpackScratch. ES2's Bitmap_UseCallerScratch (DBSIM 006c5ff8).

entries.name: Bitmap_UnpackScratch
entries.description: The buffer a packed bitmap is unpacked into for drawing: Bitmap_Blit puts it in the bitmap's data pointer +0xe for the blit and deletes it afterwards unless Bitmap_UseCallerScratch is set. ES2's Bitmap_UnpackScratch (DBSIM 006c5ffc).
